title: Richard Doty describes his role as an AFOSI counterintelligence officer
place_text: Air Force Office of Special Investigations

tellings.quote: I was a Counter Intelligence officer for the Air Force offic Special investigation

plain: Richard Doty says he worked in counterintelligence for the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, often called AFOSI, the Air Force's own investigative service. He says so himself on the show: "I was a Counter Intelligence officer for the Air Force Office of Special Investigations," a role he held in the 1970s and 80s. It matters because it would put him on the inside of how the Air Force handled sensitive matters such as UFOs.
